Messages.Author: Labrat
Messages.Body:
First off let me list the rules for the tournament i am building the deck for:-
ICON this year is a 'super-star' format..
For our purposes, this means a minimum of 4 copies of a unique vampire (or 30%) needs to be present in your crypt. Advanced versions count towards this total (e.g. 3 ADV Nergal + 1 base Nergal satisfies this requirement).
If your 'super-star' is involved in ousting your prey, you get 1 extra pool (i.e. bleed, deflect, vote, etc).
If another Methuselah causes you to lose control of your 'super-star' (i.e. burn, diablerie, theft, etc), you lose a pool.
A nice combo here would be to burn your prey`s 'super-star' when they have 1 pool to claim a tidy 7 pool to continue your turn.
The benefit of destroying a 'super-star' goes only to the first Methuselah who performs such an act (i.e. if you play Daemonic Possession on a dead 'super-star', or if you burn an already corrupted 'super-star', you do not cause the affected Methuselah to lose another pool.).

Ok
So my idea is to play Scot Youngwood as my 'super-star'
Her combo(if it works) is to use her ability, then play Propaganda, Play Phantom speaker as a mod…trying to tap out the other Methuselah . She also needs to use “concert tour” and “freak drive” “villain”

Then bleed with the horde…
I was also keen on the horde using “kaymakli Fragments” and maybe ranged agg + Amaranth .

What other ideas do you have.

I think my concept might be trying to do too much

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Scout is better in a vote deck than in a bleed deck in my opinion. She can get support from other interesting vampires, and bleed can be seen as a "plan B".
Otherwise, OBF is a far better stealth discipline than MEL. You can add a few Virtuosa for the unblockage or bleed boost effect, buth Phantom Speaker is worse than Elder Impersonation.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director
